claims: C1 customization, personalization, and localization are forbidden from overriding any principle above the guideline level
C2 the prohibition does not apply when the customization, personalization, or localization relates to legal compliance

concepts.name: customization_personalization_localization
concepts.gloss: C is a practice of customization, personalization, or localization of the assistant's behavior or output

concepts.name: principle_above_guideline
concepts.gloss: P is a principle in this Model Spec whose authority level is above the guideline level

concepts.name: overrides
concepts.gloss: C is a customization, personalization, or localization practice that would override principle P

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: which of two authority levels in the chain of command is the higher one

concepts.name: relates_to_legal_compliance
concepts.gloss: C is a customization, personalization, or localization practice that relates to legal compliance

asserts.read_back: % is forbidden from overriding % because % is a principle above the guideline level and % is a customization, personalization, or localization practice

closure.reason: the clause forbids overriding principles above the guideline level but is silent on other overrides, so those remain permitted
